# vuk-danicic fixtures

Real upstream files from **spthmpsn/Rs1Bible** (github.com/spthmpsn/Rs1Bible,
master @ a51bd9fc9922c8fcffce381e95fcc4c7fe9f0230, retrieved 2026-10-11) —
the Vuk–Daničić Serbian Bible (ijekavian, Latin transliteration) as USFM,
converted from THE UNBOUND BIBLE's "Serbian: Danicic Karadzic Latin".

| File | Shape |
|---|---|
| `31-OBA.usfm` | verbatim — Obadiah, one chapter, 21 verses (OT: Daničić) |
| `64-2JN.usfm` | verbatim — 2 John, one chapter, 13 verses (NT: Vuk) |
| `44-JHN.usfm` | TRIMMED — John, the header and chapter 1 only (lines 1–87 of the real file; 51 verses) |

The `\p` and `\s5` markers are the converter's (imported from an English
edition); the parser reads verses only. Text public domain.
